The '''Friijillis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dail sector/Legends|Dail sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Friijillis]].
